description.en: Choose the figure which is different from the rest (odd one out) using visual properties like number of sides, symmetry and shape.
description.as: দৃশ্যগত বৈশিষ্ট্য (বাহুৰ সংখ্যা, সুষমতা, আকৃতি) ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি আনবোৰতকৈ বেলেগ চিত্ৰটো বাছি উলিয়াওক (odd one out)।

q.en: Which of the following figures is the odd one out?
q.as: তলৰ চিত্ৰবোৰৰ ভিতৰত কোনটো বেলেগ (odd one out)?

explanation.en: Square, rectangle and rhombus each have 4 sides. The triangle has only 3 sides, so it is the odd one out = Option (C).
explanation.as: বৰ্গ, আয়ত আৰু ৰম্বাছ — প্ৰতিটোৰে ৪টা বাহু আছে। ত্ৰিভুজটোৰ মাত্ৰ ৩টা বাহু আছে, সেয়ে ইয়েই বেলেগ = বিকল্প (C)।

q.en: Four figures are given below. Three of them can be divided into two identical halves by a straight line (line of symmetry). Which figure does NOT have a line of symmetry?
q.as: তলত চাৰিটা চিত্ৰ দিয়া হৈছে। ইয়াৰে তিনিটাক এডাল সৰল ৰেখাই দুটা একে ভাগত ভাগ কৰিব পাৰি (প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা)। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><g transform="translate(1.765,6.588) scale(1.206)"><polygon points="40,8 74,64 6,64" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><g transform="translate(-6.769,-6.769) scale(1.577)"><circle cx="36" cy="36" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/></g></svg>

explanation.en: The isosceles triangle, rectangle and circle all have at least one line of symmetry. A (slanted) parallelogram has no line of symmetry = Option (C).
explanation.as: সমদ্বিবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ, আয়ত আৰু বৃত্ত — প্ৰত্যেকৰে কমেও এডাল প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা আছে। (বেঁকা) সামান্তৰিকৰ কোনো প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই = বিকল্প (C)।

q.en: Four figures are given below. Three of them are closed figures while one is an open figure. Which is the odd one out?
q.as: তলত চাৰিটা চিত্ৰ দিয়া হৈছে। ইয়াৰে তিনিটা বন্ধ চিত্ৰ আৰু এটা খোলা চিত্ৰ। কোনটো বেলেগ?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="22" y="22" width="56" height="56" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polyline points="30,25 30,75 70,75 70,25" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,15 90,80 10,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

explanation.en: The square (A), triangle (C) and circle (D) are closed figures. Option B is an open figure whose two ends are not joined, so it is the odd one out.
explanation.as: বৰ্গ (A), ত্ৰিভুজ (C) আৰু বৃত্ত (D) — এইকেইটা বন্ধ চিত্ৰ। বিকল্প B খোলা চিত্ৰ, ইয়াৰ দুটা মূৰ সংযুক্ত নহয়, সেয়ে ইয়েই বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures are formed only with straight lines. Which figure is formed with a curved line?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰ কেৱল সৰল ৰেখাৰে গঠিত। কোনটো চিত্ৰ বক্ৰ ৰেখাৰে গঠিত?

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="22" y="22" width="56" height="56" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

explanation.en: Triangle (B), square (C) and pentagon (D) have only straight sides. The oval (A) has only a curved boundary, so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: ত্ৰিভুজ (B), বৰ্গ (C) আৰু পঞ্চভুজ (D) — এইকেইটাৰ কেৱল সৰল বাহু আছে। কণী আকৃতিৰ চিত্ৰ (A) ৰ সীমা কেৱল বক্ৰ, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures can be divided into two identical halves by a straight line (line of symmetry). Which figure has NO line of symmetry?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰক এডাল সৰল ৰেখাই দুটা একে ভাগত ভাগ কৰিব পাৰি (প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা)। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ কোনো প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="30,24 90,24 66,76 6,76" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: The isosceles triangle (A), rectangle (B) and regular hexagon (C) each have a line of symmetry. The slanted parallelogram (D) has no line of symmetry, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: সমদ্বিবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ (A), আয়ত (B) আৰু সুষম ষড়ভুজ (C) — প্ৰত্যেকৰে প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা আছে। বেঁকা সামান্তৰিক (D) ৰ কোনো প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures have the same number of sides. Which figure has a different number of sides?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰৰ বাহুৰ সংখ্যা একে। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ বাহুৰ সংখ্যা বেলেগ?

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Options A, C and D are regular pentagons having 5 sides each. Option B is a regular hexagon having 6 sides, so B is the odd one out.
explanation.as: বিকল্প A, C আৰু D — প্ৰত্যেকটো ৫টা বাহুৰ সুষম পঞ্চভুজ। বিকল্প B এটা ৬টা বাহুৰ সুষম ষড়ভুজ, সেয়ে B বেলেগ।

q.en: Each square below is divided into two parts by one diagonal. In three squares the diagonal slants in the same direction. Which square is the odd one out?
q.as: তলৰ প্ৰতিটো বৰ্গ এডাল কৰ্ণেৰে দুটা ভাগত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে। তিনিটা বৰ্গত কৰ্ণডাল একে দিশলৈ হাল্চি আছে। কোনটো বৰ্গ বেলেগ?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="80" y1="20" x2="20" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: In A, B and D the diagonal runs from top-left to bottom-right (\). Only in C it runs from top-right to bottom-left (/), so C is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু D ত কৰ্ণডাল ওপৰ-বাওঁফালৰ পৰা তল-সোঁফাললৈ (\) গৈছে। কেৱল C ত ই ওপৰ-সোঁফালৰ পৰা তল-বাওঁফাললৈ (/) গৈছে, সেয়ে C বেলেগ।

q.en: Four squares are divided by straight lines into smaller parts. Three are divided into two equal parts. Which square is divided into four equal parts?
q.as: চাৰিটা বৰ্গক সৰল ৰেখাই সৰু ভাগত ভাগ কৰিছে। তিনিটা বৰ্গক দুটা সমান ভাগত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে। কোনটো বৰ্গক চাৰিটা সমান ভাগত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="20" y1="50" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="50" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Square A is cut by one vertical and one horizontal line through its centre, giving 4 equal small squares. B, C and D are divided into only 2 equal parts, so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: বৰ্গ A ক মাজেৰে এডাল উলম্ব আৰু এডাল অনুভূমিক ৰেখাই কাটিলে ৪টা সমান সৰু বৰ্গ হয়। B, C আৰু D কেৱল ২টা সমান ভাগত বিভক্ত, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Three figures are divided into two equal halves by a straight line. In which figure are the two parts NOT equal?
q.as: তিনিটা চিত্ৰক এডাল সৰল ৰেখাই দুটা সমান ভাগত ভাগ কৰিছে। কোনটো চিত্ৰত দুটা ভাগ সমান নহয়?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="50" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="44" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="6" x2="50" y2="94" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="62" y1="20" x2="62" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: In A, B and C the dividing line passes through the centre, making two equal halves. In D the vertical line is not at the centre, so the two parts are unequal; D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু C ত ভাগ কৰা ৰেখাডাল মাজেৰে যায়, ফলত দুটা সমান ভাগ হয়। D ত উলম্ব ৰেখাডাল মাজত নাই, সেয়ে দুটা ভাগ অসমান; D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures open towards the same direction. Which one opens towards the opposite direction?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰ একে দিশলৈ মুখ কৰি আছে। কোনটো বিপৰীত দিশলৈ মুখ কৰি আছে?

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polyline points="72,20 28,50 72,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Chevrons A, B and C have their vertex pointing to the right. D has its vertex pointing to the left, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু C ৰ শীৰ্ষটো সোঁফাললৈ আছে। D ৰ শীৰ্ষটো বাওঁফাললৈ আছে, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these circles are of the same size. Which circle is different in size?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা বৃত্তৰ আকাৰ একে। কোনটো বৃত্তৰ আকাৰ বেলেগ?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="36" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="36" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="36" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

explanation.en: Circles A, C and D have the same radius. Circle B is bigger, so B is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, C আৰু D বৃত্তৰ ব্যাসাৰ্ধ একে। B বৃত্তটো ডাঙৰ, সেয়ে B বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures are regular pentagons (all sides equal). Which figure is NOT a regular pentagon?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰ সুষম পঞ্চভুজ (আটাইবোৰ বাহু সমান)। কোনটো চিত্ৰ সুষম পঞ্চভুজ নহয়?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="18,84 18,44 50,10 82,44 82,84" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: A, B and D are identical regular pentagons with all sides equal. C is a house-shaped pentagon whose sides are not all equal, so C is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু D — এইকেইটা সমান বাহুৰ সুষম পঞ্চভুজ। C এটা ঘৰৰ আকৃতিৰ পঞ্চভুজ, ইয়াৰ আটাইবোৰ বাহু সমান নহয়, সেয়ে C বেলেগ।

q.en: Four figures are given below. Three of them have 4 sides each. Which figure has only 3 sides?
q.as: তলত চাৰিটা চিত্ৰ দিয়া হৈছে। ইয়াৰে তিনিটাৰ প্ৰতিটোতে ৪টা বাহু আছে। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ মাত্ৰ ৩টা বাহু আছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="22" y="22" width="56" height="56" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="12" y="28" width="76" height="44" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="30,24 90,24 66,76 6,76" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Square (B), rectangle (C) and parallelogram (D) have 4 sides each. The triangle (A) has only 3 sides, so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: বৰ্গ (B), আয়ত (C) আৰু সামান্তৰিক (D) — প্ৰত্যেকৰে ৪টা বাহু আছে। ত্ৰিভুজ (A) ৰ মাত্ৰ ৩টা বাহু আছে, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures can be divided into two identical halves by a straight line (line of symmetry). Which figure has NO line of symmetry?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰক এডাল সৰল ৰেখাই দুটা একে ভাগত ভাগ কৰিব পাৰি (প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা)। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ কোনো প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="30,25 70,25 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 82.9,31 82.9,69 50,88 17.1,69 17.1,31" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="24" y="24" width="52" height="52" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="18,78 30,25 80,20 60,75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: The isosceles trapezium (A), regular hexagon (B) and square (C) each have a line of symmetry. The asymmetric quadrilateral (D) has no line of symmetry, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: সমদ্বিবাহু ট্ৰেপিজিয়াম (A), সুষম ষড়ভুজ (B) আৰু বৰ্গ (C) — প্ৰত্যেকৰে প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা আছে। অসমতীয় চতুৰ্ভুজ (D) ৰ কোনো প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures are closed figures. Which figure is an open figure?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰ বন্ধ চিত্ৰ। কোনটো চিত্ৰ খোলা?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Triangle (A), square (C) and pentagon (D) are closed figures. Option B is an open zigzag line whose ends are not joined, so B is the odd one out.
explanation.as: ত্ৰিভুজ (A), বৰ্গ (C) আৰু পঞ্চভুজ (D) — এইকেইটা বন্ধ চিত্ৰ। বিকল্প B এডাল খোলা বেঁকা-পটীয়া ৰেখা, ইয়াৰ মূৰ দুটা সংযুক্ত নহয়, সেয়ে B বেলেগ।

q.en: Three figures below are made only of straight lines. Which figure is made of a curved line?
q.as: তলৰ তিনিটা চিত্ৰ কেৱল সৰল ৰেখাৰে তৈয়াৰী। কোনটো চিত্ৰ বক্ৰ ৰেখাৰে তৈয়াৰী?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="15" y="30" width="70" height="40" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="30" ry="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

explanation.en: Rectangle (A), pentagon (B) and triangle (C) have only straight sides. The oval (D) has only a curved outline, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: আয়ত (A), পঞ্চভুজ (B) আৰু ত্ৰিভুজ (C) — কেৱল সৰল বাহু আছে। কণী আকৃতিৰ চিত্ৰ (D) ৰ আউটলাইন কেৱল বক্ৰ, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures have a line of symmetry. Which figure does NOT have a line of symmetry?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰৰ প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা আছে। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা নাই?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,19 85,80 15,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 88,37.6 73.5,82.4 26.5,82.4 12,37.6" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="30,25 70,25 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="8,24 68,24 92,76 32,76" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Equilateral triangle (A), regular pentagon (B) and isosceles trapezium (C) each have a line of symmetry. The slanted parallelogram (D) has none, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: সমবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ (A), সুষম পঞ্চভুজ (B) আৰু সমদ্বিবাহু ট্ৰেপিজিয়াম (C) — প্ৰত্যেকৰে প্ৰতিসাম্য ৰেখা আছে। বেঁকা সামান্তৰিক (D) ৰ নাই, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures have four sides. Which figure has six sides?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰৰ চাৰিটা বাহু আছে। কোনটো চিত্ৰৰ ছটা বাহু আছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="25" width="60" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 82.9,31 82.9,69 50,88 17.1,69 17.1,31" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="25" y="25" width="50" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,10 90,50 50,90 10,50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Rectangle (A), square (C) and rhombus (D) are quadrilaterals (4 sides). Hexagon (B) has 6 sides, so B is the odd one out.
explanation.as: আয়ত (A), বৰ্গ (C) আৰু ৰম্বাছ (D) — চতুৰ্ভুজ (৪টা বাহু)। ষড়ভুজ (B) ৰ ৬টা বাহু, সেয়ে B বেলেগ।

q.en: Each square is divided by one diagonal. In three squares the diagonal slants from top-left to bottom-right. Which square is divided by the other diagonal?
q.as: প্ৰতিটো বৰ্গ এডাল কৰ্ণেৰে ভাগ কৰা হৈছে। তিনিটা বৰ্গত কৰ্ণডাল ওপৰ-বাওঁফালৰ পৰা তল-সোঁফাললৈ গৈছে। কোনটো বৰ্গ আনটো কৰ্ণেৰে ভাগ কৰা হৈছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="80" y1="20" x2="20" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: B, C and D have the diagonal from top-left to bottom-right (\). Only A has the diagonal from top-right to bottom-left (/), so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: B, C আৰু D ত কৰ্ণডাল ওপৰ-বাওঁফালৰ পৰা তল-সোঁফাললৈ (\) গৈছে। কেৱল A ত ই ওপৰ-সোঁফালৰ পৰা তল-বাওঁফাললৈ (/) গৈছে, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Four circles are divided by straight lines. Three are divided into two equal parts. Which circle is divided into four equal parts?
q.as: চাৰিটা বৃত্তক সৰল ৰেখাই ভাগ কৰিছে। তিনিটা বৃত্তক দুটা সমান ভাগত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে। কোনটো বৃত্তক চাৰিটা সমান ভাগত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="8" x2="50" y2="92" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="8" y1="50" x2="92" y2="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="8" x2="50" y2="92" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="8" y1="50" x2="92" y2="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20.3" y1="20.3" x2="79.7" y2="79.7" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Circle A is cut by one vertical and one horizontal diameter, giving 4 equal parts. B, C and D are divided into only 2 parts, so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: বৃত্ত A ক এডাল উলম্ব আৰু এডাল অনুভূমিক ব্যাসে কাটিলে ৪টা সমান ভাগ হয়। B, C আৰু D কেৱল ২টা ভাগত বিভক্ত, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Three figures are divided into two equal halves. In which figure are the two parts NOT equal?
q.as: তিনিটা চিত্ৰ দুটা সমান অৰ্ধত ভাগ কৰা হৈছে। কোনটো চিত্ৰত দুটা ভাগ সমান নহয়?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="15" y="25" width="70" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="50" y1="25" x2="50" y2="75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="20" y1="20" x2="80" y2="80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="15" y="25" width="70" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><line x1="62" y1="25" x2="62" y2="75" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: A, B and C are each cut into two equal halves by a line through the centre. In D the vertical line is not central, so the two parts are unequal; D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু C — প্ৰত্যেককে মাজেৰে যোৱা ৰেখাই দুটা সমান অৰ্ধত কাটিছে। D ত উলম্ব ৰেখাডাল মাজত নাই, সেয়ে দুটা ভাগ অসমান; D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three triangles point in the same direction. Which triangle points in a different direction?
q.as: তিনিটা ত্ৰিভুজ একে দিশলৈ আছে। কোনটো ত্ৰিভুজ বেলেগ দিশলৈ আছে?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,12 88,80 12,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="12,20 88,20 50,88" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: Triangles A, B and C point upward. Triangle D points downward, so D is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু C ত্ৰিভুজ ওপৰলৈ আছে। D ত্ৰিভুজটো তললৈ আছে, সেয়ে D বেলেগ।

q.en: Three squares are of the same size. Which square is different in size?
q.as: তিনিটা বৰ্গৰ আকাৰ একে। কোনটো বৰ্গৰ আকাৰ বেলেগ?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="12" y="12" width="76" height="76" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="25" y="25" width="50" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="25" y="25" width="50" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><rect x="25" y="25" width="50" height="50" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>

explanation.en: Squares B, C and D are equal in size. Square A is bigger, so A is the odd one out.
explanation.as: B, C আৰু D বৰ্গৰ আকাৰ সমান। A বৰ্গটো ডাঙৰ, সেয়ে A বেলেগ।

q.en: Three of these figures are equilateral triangles (all sides equal). Which figure is NOT an equilateral triangle?
q.as: ইয়াৰে তিনিটা চিত্ৰ সমবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ (আটাইবোৰ বাহু সমান)। কোনটো চিত্ৰ সমবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ নহয়?

options.fig: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,19 85,80 15,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,19 85,80 15,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="15,25 15,80 85,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"><polygon points="50,19 85,80 15,80" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

explanation.en: A, B and D are equilateral triangles with all sides equal. C is a right-angled triangle whose sides are unequal, so C is the odd one out.
explanation.as: A, B আৰু D — সমান বাহুৰ সমবাহু ত্ৰিভুজ। C এটা সমকোণী ত্ৰিভুজ, ইয়াৰ বাহুবোৰ অসমান, সেয়ে C বেলেগ।
